The Creative Agreement

Permanent / flexible.

Permanent

Purpose, audience, values, approved logos, colors, typography, voice, and asset-fidelity requirements.

Flexible

Application, composition, image crop, scale, placement, camera position, deliverable format, and context-specific production needs.

Text Assistance

Briefs, copy drafts, and prompt structure. Review meaning and voice.

Image Generation

Atmosphere and application studies. Review fidelity and realism.

Code Assistance

Layouts and interactions. Test behavior and accessibility.
